name: @monet-ui/monet-timeline
description: Monet — framework-free non-linear timeline engine: generic track/clip model, editing operations (split/ripple/trim/slip/slide/roll), an observable clone-on-write store, and frame/timecode math. Shared across the Monet NLE apps (Cinema video, Rythme audio).
author: Monet / monet-ui
//: Framework-agnostic: NO React/DOM imports, so it runs in node/workers too. Unit-agnostic: time values are plain numbers (frames for video, seconds for audio) — the host app chooses. dist/ is built fresh by prepare/prepublishOnly.
